about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Alexandria Renew Enterprises (AlexRenew WRRF and Alexandria combined sewer outfalls)
channels.note: AlexRenew CSO email alerts (Real Magnet form). Voluntary list. https://alexrenew.com/our-work/cso-tracking/alerts answered 403 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. Sign-up status: not attempted (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Alexandria Renew Enterprises (AlexRenew WRRF and Alexandria combined sewer outfalls)
channels.note: AlexRenew CSO status (red if an overflow in the past 24 hours). Basis not cited in the research (permit administratively continued; RiverRenew in service 2026-07-01). (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Arlington County DES (Water Pollution Control Plant and collection system)
channels.note: Arlington County news and Arlington Alert advisories. Voluntary ad hoc advisories (2012-2022 Four Mile Run spills); homepage URL. (research/va/report.md §3)

channels.name: Chesapeake Bay Foundation
channels.note: Chesapeake Bay Foundation. Voluntary. Advocacy; no data. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Virginia DEQ
channels.legal_basis: Va. Code § 62.1-44.19:6 B: DEQ provides the report to VDH and to local newspapers, television and radio, and disseminates it by official social media and email lists, when VDH finds a risk to health or DEQ finds the discharge may impair beneficial uses (no deadline)
channels.note: DEQ email notification lists (GovDelivery). The list's RSS carried no 2026 spill notice. Sign-up status: not attempted (docs/subscriptions.md). Covers every operator in the state. (research/va/report.md §2, §4)

channels.name: Virginia DEQ
channels.legal_basis: Va. Code § 62.1-44.19:6 B: DEQ provides the report to VDH and to local newspapers, television and radio, and disseminates it by official social media and email lists, when VDH finds a risk to health or DEQ finds the discharge may impair beneficial uses (no deadline)
channels.note: No web form: DEQ notice to VDH and local newspapers, television and radio. No web form. Covers every operator in the state. (research/va/report.md §2)
channels.barrier_review: the register does not say what keeps it off the web: no web form: deq notice to vdh and local newspapers, television and radio. no web form. covers every operator in the sta

channels.name: Virginia DEQ
channels.note: DEQ Pollution Response Program (PReP) reports, search page and API. Voluntary publication: overflows are reported to DEQ within 24 hours (Va. Code § 62.1-44.5 B; 9VAC25-31-190 L 6-7); routine permitted CSOs are not in PReP. Covers every operator in the state. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Virginia DEQ
channels.legal_basis: Va. Code § 62.1-44.19:6 B: DEQ provides the report to VDH and to local newspapers, television and radio, and disseminates it by official social media and email lists, when VDH finds a risk to health or DEQ finds the discharge may impair beneficial uses (no deadline)
channels.note: DEQ official social media (X @VirginiaDEQ). Whether DEQ uses X for spills is unverified. Covers every operator in the state. (research/va/report.md §2, §4)

channels.name: Virginia DEQ
channels.note: DEQ Topics of Interest pages for large spills (Douglas Avenue, S. 1st Ave, Potomac Interceptor). Voluntary pages for big events (Douglas Avenue page given; also S. 1st Ave and Potomac Interceptor). https://www.deq.virginia.gov/news-info/shortcuts/topics-of-interest/douglas-avenue-sewer-main-failure answered 403 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: No rows for this state in EPA's dataset: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. No VA rows in the dataset (research/va); add the state to the ingester's STATES when rows appear. Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)
channels.barrier_review: the register does not say what keeps it off the web: no rows for this state in epa's dataset: epa echo sewer overflow and bypass event records (npdes ereporting). voluntary

channels.name: Henrico County Department of Public Utilities (Henrico Water Reclamation Facility and collection system)
channels.legal_basis: 2023 settlement (CBF/JRA/EIP v. Henrico; modified DEQ consent order): 'a web-based map that is updated daily'
channels.note: Henrico sanitary sewer overflow map (no dates). 273 points without dates; door hangers and bill inserts. https://henrico.gov/utility/public-data/sanitary-sewer-event-overflow-map-sso/ answered 403 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Hampton Roads Sanitation District (HRSD)
channels.note: HRSD newsroom (major failures). Voluntary; no routine SSO list; door-to-door notice for big events. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: James River Association
channels.note: James River Association, James River Watch. Voluntary. ArcGIS layer of weekly bacteria. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: City of Lynchburg Water Resources (Lynchburg Regional Wastewater Treatment Plant)
channels.note: Lynchburg Alerts (Everbridge) CSO text and email; second alert 30 hours after the end. Voluntary; account required; no public archive of alerts. Sign-up status: not attempted (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: City of Lynchburg Water Resources (Lynchburg Regional Wastewater Treatment Plant)
channels.note: Lynchburg CSO system page. Voluntary page explaining the alerts. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Lynnhaven River NOW water quality
channels.note: Lynnhaven River NOW water quality. Voluntary. Monthly Google Sheet. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: City of Newport News Public Works, Wastewater Division
channels.note: Newport News annual SSO report (DOCX, table as an image). Voluntary annual report. (research/va/report.md §2)

channels.name: Virginia sewer system operators
channels.note: Other SSO reporters' own notices (WVWA, Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Fairfax, Chesterfield and others). Voluntary only: Virginia law places no public notice duty on the discharger; none found. Covers: va-covington, va-hopewell-water-renewal, va-wvwa, va-norfolk-utilities, va-virginia-beach-utilities, va-portsmouth, va-fairfax-dpwes, va-chesterfield-utilities, va-tappahannock, va-dickenson-psa, va-front-royal, va-alleghany-lower-jackson, va-christiansburg, va-fredericksburg, va-bedford, va-fcwsa-remington. (research/va/report.md §2-3)

channels.name: Virginia Department of Health
channels.note: VDH recreational water advisories (news RSS). Voluntary: VDH issues advisories at its discretion; DEQ must pass reports to VDH under § 62.1-44.19:6 B. Covers every operator in the state. (research/va/report.md §2)
